# Bowdoin Library

> Bowdoin Library provides comprehensive research resources, discovery tools, and academic support services for Bowdoin College students and faculty.

The library serves as the central hub for research at Bowdoin College, offering access to the Compass discovery system, subject-specific research guides, citation resources, and interlibrary loan services. The site includes research methodology guides, librarian consultation services, and facilities management tools.

## Key Topics

- Compass discovery system
- Research methodology
- Citation guides (MLA, APA, Chicago, CSE)
- Source evaluation
- Primary and secondary sources
- Scholarly vs. popular articles
- Interlibrary loan
- Subject liaison librarians
- Course reserves
- Information literacy
- Government documents
- Copyright and fair use
- Academic writing
- Library catalog search
- MaineCat consortium

## Core Research Resources

- [Bowdoin Library](https://library.bowdoin.edu): Bowdoin Library homepage with research resources and collections.
- [Library Website Search](https://library.bowdoin.edu/library-search.shtml): Compass discovery system and library catalog search interface.
- [Research](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research): Research resources hub with guides, databases, and librarian help.
- [Library Services](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services): Overview of library services including reserves, ILL, and facilities.

## Research Guides & Methodology

- [Steps in the Research Process](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/steps-in-the-research-process.shtml): Step-by-step guide to the academic research process at Bowdoin.
- [Evaluating Sources](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/evaluating-sources.shtml): Guide to evaluating web sources for authority, accuracy, objectivity.
- [Primary and Secondary Sources](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/primary-and-secondary-sources.shtml): Research guide distinguishing primary and secondary source types.
- [Scholarly vs. Popular Articles](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/scholarly-vs-popular-articles.shtml): Guide comparing scholarly and popular publications for academic work.

## Citation & Academic Writing

- [Style and Citation Guides](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/citation-guides.shtml): Citation guides in MLA, APA, Chicago, CSE and discipline-specific styles.

## Research Support & Librarian Services

- [Research Librarians by Subject](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/research-librarians-by-subject.shtml): Directory of subject liaison librarians for research consultation.
- [Research and Instruction Services](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/instruction-program.shtml): Information literacy instruction and research learning outcomes.
- [Bowdoin Digital Delivery and Interlibrary Loan](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/interlibrary-loan-and-document-delivery.shtml): Interlibrary loan and digital delivery service for research materials.

## Collections & Special Resources

- [Government Documents](https://library.bowdoin.edu/collections/government-documents/index.shtml): Federal and state depository with U.S. government and Maine documents.
- [Copyright](https://library.bowdoin.edu/research/copyright/index.shtml): Copyright policies and fair use guidelines for Bowdoin College.

## Faculty & Student Services

- [Reserve: Faculty Submissions Forms](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/reserves): Faculty forms and procedures for course reserves and media.
- [Course Adoptions](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/services-for-faculty/course-adoptions): Faculty service for course material adoption and textbook ordering.
- [Reserve A Study Carrel](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/reserve-a-study-carrel.shtml): Study carrel reservation service across Bowdoin libraries.
- [Library Takeout](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/library-take-out-service): Library material request and pickup service via Compass.

## Optional

- [Sign In](https://library.bowdoin.edu/services/order-forms): Okta authentication and login portal for library services.
